DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 材料についてのご質問と伺いました。調理を担当しておりますので、気になる料理を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: I understand you have a question about ingredients. I am responsible for cooking, so please tell me which dish concerns you.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この焼き魚を頼もうと思っていますが、牛乳アレルギーがあります。白いソースに牛乳や生クリームは入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乳製品の使用を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am thinking of ordering this grilled fish, but I have a milk allergy. Does the white sauce contain milk or fresh cream?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether dairy products are used.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: このソースには生クリームを使っています。魚の下味にも乳製品を使う工程があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: This sauce contains fresh cream. There is also a stage in seasoning the fish that uses dairy products.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ソースを外すだけでは避けられないのですね。下味を付けていない魚から作ってもらうことはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ソース除去以外の対応可否を知る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: So removing the sauce would not be enough to avoid them. Could you make it using fish that has not been seasoned yet?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether an option beyond simply removing the sauce is possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日は下味を付けた分しかご用意がありません。別の料理について材料を調べることはできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Today we only have fish that has already been seasoned. We can check the ingredients of another dish.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、メニューの豆腐料理を調べてもらいたいです。材料だけでなく、乳製品を使う料理との器具の共用も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 代替候補の条件を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I would like you to check the tofu dish on the menu. Besides the ingredients, I also want to know whether utensils are shared with dishes using dairy products.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese the conditions for an alternative dish.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 材料の表示と厨房の扱いを確認します。共用の器具があるため、乳製品の混入がないと断定はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check the ingredient labels and how the kitchen handles it. Because some utensils are shared, we cannot state that no dairy can get into it.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その条件だと自分では判断しきれません。料理の注文はまだせず、説明を同行者に伝えて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不明な条件で注文を確定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I cannot make a confident decision myself under those conditions. I will not order food yet; I will explain this to my companion and discuss it with them.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not finalize an order with conditions still unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認した内容をメモでお渡しできますので、料理名と乳製品の使用工程を書いておきましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. I can give you a written note of what we checked. Shall I write the dish names and the steps where dairy is used?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。焼き魚は注文しないことと、別の料理も未決定であることをメモに入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同行者と確認する情報を残す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. Please also include that I am not ordering the grilled fish and have not decided on another dish either.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to keep a record of the information to discuss with your companion.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご注文は保留のままにして、材料の説明をお渡しします。決まりましたらお呼びください。私は厨房へ戻りますので、いったん失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will keep your order on hold and give you the ingredient explanation. Please call us when you decide. I will return to the kitchen now, so excuse me for the moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は苗箱を作業台から屋根の下へ移します。水やりは私がしますので、運ぶ方をお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Today we will move the seedling trays from the workbench to under the roof. I will handle the watering; could you handle carrying them?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 運ぶ方を担当します。乾いて見える箱もありますが、自分で水をかけずに、そのまま移せばよいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 作業の役割を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will do the carrying. Some trays look dry, but I should move them as they are without watering them myself, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Confirm the division of work in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい、水は私が見て調整します。苗箱は両手で底を支え、傾けないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes, I will check and adjust the water. Support the bottom of each seedling tray with both hands and keep it from tilting.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一箱ずつ運びたいです。屋根の下では、ラベルの面を通路側へ向けて並べればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 箱を指定どおりに並べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like to carry one tray at a time. Under the roof, should I line them up with their label sides facing the passage?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese how to arrange the trays as instructed.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その向きでお願いします。ただし先に運んだ箱と重ねず、この空いた棚の段に置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please use that orientation. However, do not stack them on trays already moved; put them on this empty shelf level.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この段なら置けそうです。途中の通路にホースが伸びているので、運ぶ前に片づけてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 運搬前に障害物への対応を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: They look as though they will fit on this level. A hose is lying across the route, so could you clear it before I carry them?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for an obstacle to be dealt with before carrying the trays.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 私が水を止めてホースを寄せます。それが済むまで苗箱を持ち上げず、作業台の横で待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will turn off the water and move the hose aside. Until that is done, do not lift a seedling tray; wait beside the workbench.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 待っている間に、箱の底を持つ位置を教えてください。指を棚との間にはさみそうで気になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 置くときの扱いを確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: While I wait, please show me where to hold the bottom of the tray. I am concerned that my fingers may get caught between it and the shelf.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese how to handle a tray when setting it down.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今、空の箱で持ち方をお見せします。棚へ置くときも無理に押し込まず、両側に指を抜ける余裕を取ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will show you how to hold an empty tray now. When putting it on the shelf, do not force it in; leave enough space on both sides to withdraw your fingers.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 空の箱で一度練習します。ホースが片づいたら一箱ずつ棚へ運び、置きにくい箱があれば止めて呼びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指定した手順で苗箱を運ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will practice once with an empty tray. Once the hose is clear, I will carry them to the shelf one at a time, and stop and call you if any is difficult to put down.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will carry the seedling trays using the specified procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 練習を見てから運び始めましょう。私はホースを片づけてきますので、その場でお待ちください。では、少し失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let us start carrying after I watch your practice. I will go clear the hose, so please wait there. Excuse me for a moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物の発送ですね。中に入っているものを教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to send a parcel. Could you tell me what is inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 陶器の湯飲みを二つ入れました。箱を傾けると中で音がするので、この状態で預けてよいか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 発送前に梱包状態を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I put two ceramic teacups inside. They make a noise when I tilt the box, so I am worried about handing it over like this.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Consult in Japanese about the packing condition before sending the parcel.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 割れ物は中で動かないように、それぞれを保護していただく必要があります。二つの湯飲みの間にも緩衝材を入れていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Each fragile item needs protection so it cannot move inside. Have you also placed cushioning between the two teacups?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一枚の新聞紙でまとめて包んだだけです。別々に包み直して、箱の隙間も埋めた方がよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 陶器同士が当たらない梱包にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only wrapped them together in one sheet of newspaper. I should wrap them separately and fill the empty spaces in the box too, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese how to pack the ceramics so they do not knock against each other.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、互いに当たらないようにしてください。梱包の確認はできますが、輸送中に絶対に割れないと保証することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, please keep them from hitting each other. We can check the packing, but we cannot guarantee that they will absolutely not break during transport.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: わかりました。まず家で包み直します。宛名はこのメモを使いたいのですが、建物名を省いても届きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 梱包と宛先の不明点を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will first rewrap them at home. I want to use this note for the address; will it arrive if I leave out the building name?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about unclear packing and address details.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 宛先を正確に記入していただくため、わかる建物名や部屋番号もお書きください。メモでは部屋番号が見当たりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: To provide an accurate address, please also write any building name and room number you know. I cannot see a room number in the note.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人に部屋番号を聞いてから書きます。包み直すと箱が大きくなりそうですが、料金はこの箱のままの見積もりで決まりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 最終料金が決まる条件を理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will ask my friend for the room number before writing it. The box may become bigger when I repack it; is the price fixed by an estimate for this box as it is now?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese so you understand what determines the final charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 最終的な大きさや重さ、選ぶサービスで料金を確認します。再度お持ちになった際に、梱包した状態でご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the price based on the final size, weight, and service you choose. When you bring it back, we will explain the price with it fully packed.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は預けずに持ち帰ります。部屋番号を確かめて、一つずつ保護してから、箱を閉じた状態でまた持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不足を直してから発送する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take it home rather than leave it today. I will confirm the room number, protect each cup separately, and bring it back with the box closed.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will correct the missing details before sending it.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 再梱包後にお持ちください。その際は発送方法も一緒に確認しましょう。湯飲みが動かないよう気をつけてお持ち帰りください。それでは、またお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please bring it after repacking. We will check the sending method together then too. Take care carrying it home so the teacups do not move. We look forward to seeing you again.

DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この模型をご覧になると、城の建物と周りの地形の関係がわかりやすいですよ。
DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-01.translation: This model helps you understand the relationship between the castle buildings and the surrounding terrain.

DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 模型には小さな建物がたくさんありますね。全部、今も同じ場所に残っているのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 模型の建物が今も同じ場所に全部残るか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are lots of small buildings in the model. Are they all still in the same places today?
DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether all the buildings in the model still remain in the same places.

DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 昔の姿を表した部分もあります。ここに説明がありますので、現在の案内図とは分けて見てください。
DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-03.translation: Some parts show how it looked in the past. There is an explanation here, so please view it separately from the current visitor map.

DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昔の姿を再現した模型なのですね。この説明の「復元」という言葉は、元の形を考えて作り直すという意味ですか。
DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昔の姿の模型と理解し復元は元の形を考えて作り直す意味か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the model reproduces its past appearance. Does “reconstruction” in this explanation mean recreating something based on its original form?
DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you understand the model shows the past and ask whether reconstruction means recreating the original form.

DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 大まかにはそういう意味です。何をもとにした復元かは、この展示の解説にあります。詳しい点は担当職員にも確認できます。
DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-05.translation: Broadly, yes. The exhibit explanation says what the reconstruction was based on. You can also ask the responsible staff about the details.

DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その解説を読んでみます。あとで調べたいので、模型と説明文を一緒に撮ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 解説を読み後で調べるため模型と説明文を一緒に撮影できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will read that explanation. I would like to research it later; may I photograph the model and explanation together?
DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will read the explanation, and ask whether you may photograph it with the model for later research.

DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 模型のそばには撮影可の表示がありますが、横の資料は別の展示です。資料の表示もそれぞれご確認ください。
DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is a photography-permitted sign by the model, but the materials beside it are a different exhibit. Please check each item's signs too.

DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 横の資料は撮影禁止と書いてありました。模型だけ撮って、資料の内容は自分でメモします。
DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 資料は撮影禁止と確認し模型だけ撮り資料はメモすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-08.translation: The materials beside it said photography is prohibited. I will photograph only the model and take my own notes about those materials.
DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you checked the ban for the materials and will photograph only the model while taking notes about the materials.

DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 模型を撮るときも、通路をふさがないようお願いします。ほかの方の顔や、撮影禁止の資料が写り込まない位置を選んでください。
DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also avoid blocking the passage when photographing the model. Choose a position that will not include other visitors' faces or the materials that cannot be photographed.

DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 人が通り終わってから、模型だけが入る角度で撮ります。わからない説明はメモして職員に尋ねます。
DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 人が通った後に模型のみ写し不明な説明をメモして職員に尋ねると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait for people to pass, then take a picture from an angle that includes only the model. I will note explanations I do not understand and ask a staff member.
DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will photograph only the model after people pass, and note unclear explanations to ask the staff.

DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ、解説もゆっくりご覧ください。丸亀での見学が楽しい時間になりますように。
DLG-SC-KGW-MARUGAME-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your time reading the explanation too. I hope you enjoy your visit in Marugame.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご注文の前にお聞きになりたいことがあれば、こちらで伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: If there is anything you would like to ask before ordering, I can help you here.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 乳製品にアレルギーがあります。麺とだし、それにトッピングを別々に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乳製品アレルギーで麺、だし、トッピングを別々に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a dairy allergy. I would like to check the noodles, broth, and toppings separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have a dairy allergy and want to check noodles, broth, and toppings separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 確認する商品を絞って、原材料と調理の状況を調べます。どのうどんをお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us narrow down the product and check its ingredients and preparation. Which udon are you considering?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 温かいかけうどんです。何も載せなければ大丈夫だと自分で判断してはいけないですよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 温かいかけうどんを希望し無添加の見た目だけで大丈夫と判断できないか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hot plain udon in broth. I should not decide on my own that it is all right just because there are no toppings, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want hot plain udon and confirm that its plain appearance alone does not establish that it is all right.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。だしや麺に使う材料も確認が必要です。また、原材料に記載がなくても、調理中にほかの商品と接触する可能性があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Correct. The ingredients used in both the broth and noodles need to be checked. Also, even if something is not listed as an ingredient, contact with other products during preparation is possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まず原材料の資料を見たいです。天ぷらはまだ取らずに、麺とだしの説明を聞いてから考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 原材料資料を見たく天ぷらを取らず麺とだしの説明後に考えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: First I would like to see the ingredient information. I will not take any tempura yet and will decide after hearing the explanation about the noodles and broth.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want ingredient information and will not take tempura before hearing about the noodles and broth.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの資料をご覧ください。仕入れ品の表示も確認します。調理場所の共用については厨房へ照会しますので、少しお時間をいただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please look at this information. We will check the supplied products' labels too. We will inquire with the kitchen about shared preparation space, so please allow a little time.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 待つ間、列を止めない場所に移動します。私の注文は、確認が終わるまで作り始めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 列を妨げない所で待ち確認終了まで注文を作り始めないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: While I wait, I will move somewhere that does not hold up the queue. Please do not start making my order until the checks are finished.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will wait without obstructing the queue and ask them not to begin preparing your order until the checks are complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: かけうどんはまだ注文として通しません。確認できた内容をお伝えしますが、安全を保証することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will not send through an order for the plain udon yet. We will tell you what we can confirm, but we cannot guarantee safety.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 説明を聞いても判断できなければ、注文は見送ります。確認が終わったら、ここで声をかけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 説明後も判断できなければ注文せず確認後は待機場所で声をかけてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: If I still cannot decide after hearing the explanation, I will not order. Please come and speak to me here when the checks are finished.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not order if you still cannot decide after the explanation, and ask the staff to speak to you at your waiting place after checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらでお声がけします。先にご相談いただき、ありがとうございました。どうぞこちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will speak to you here. Thank you for consulting us beforehand. Please wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日はうちわの紙を貼る体験をご案内します。骨組みは、こちらで用意したものを使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Today we will show you how to attach paper to a round hand fan. We will use frames that we have prepared here.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分で骨組みを削るのではなく、紙を貼る部分を体験するのですね。初めてなので手順を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 骨組み削りではなく紙貼り体験と理解し初めてなので手順を見たいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: So I will experience attaching the paper, not carving the frame myself. It is my first time, so please show me the steps.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you understand this is paper attachment rather than frame carving and want to see the steps because you are new to it.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最初に紙の向きと、のりを付ける場所を示します。余った紙を切る仕上げは、担当者が行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: First I will show you the paper's orientation and where to apply glue. The staff will do the finishing step of cutting away extra paper.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 刃物を使う仕上げはお任せします。絵柄が逆さまにならないよう、貼る前に見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 刃物の工程は担当者に任せ絵柄が逆さにならないよう貼る前の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will leave the finishing with sharp tools to you. Could you check before I glue it down so that the picture is not upside down?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will leave the sharp-tool step to the staff and ask them to check the picture's orientation before gluing.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。のりを付ける前に、この印と絵柄の上下を確認しましょう。こちらの見本と並べてご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Before applying glue, let us check this mark and the top and bottom of the picture. Please compare it with this sample beside it.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 印が持ち手側ですね。失敗しそうになったら、自分で剥がさずに先生を呼びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 印は持ち手側と確認し失敗しそうなら自分で剥がさず先生を呼ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: The mark goes toward the handle, then. If it looks as though I am making a mistake, I will call the instructor rather than peel it off myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that the mark is on the handle side and say you will call the instructor rather than peel it off yourself if something goes wrong.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのようにしてください。紙を無理に引っ張ると破れることがあります。使い終わった筆は、こちらの受け皿へ戻してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do that. Pulling hard on the paper can tear it. When you finish with the brush, return it to this tray.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 筆は受け皿に置きます。完成後すぐに鞄に入れると、のりがほかの物に付くのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 筆を受け皿に戻し完成直後に鞄へ入れると付着するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will put the brush on the tray. If I put the fan in my bag immediately after finishing, could glue get onto other things?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will return the brush to the tray and ask whether putting the finished fan straight into your bag could transfer glue to other items.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 乾き方を見てから包装しますので、仕上がってもすぐにしまわないでください。持ち帰りの状態は最後に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check how it is drying before packing it, so please do not put it away immediately even when finished. We will check its condition for taking home at the end.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 包装してもらうまで待ちます。向きを確認してから、少しずつのりを付けて始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 包装まで待ち紙の向きを確認して少しずつのりを付けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait until you pack it. I will check the paper's orientation and start by applying a little glue at a time.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will wait for packing, check the paper's orientation, and apply glue gradually.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、最初の一枚を一緒に進めましょう。道具を戻す場所も忘れずに、どうぞ体験をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us work on the first sheet together. Remember where to return the tools, and enjoy the activity.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの通知を拝見して、どちらの窓口のものか確認いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: I will look at your notice and check which office it concerns.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 税の通知なので、こちらへ来ました。勤務先で税金を引かれているのに、別の通知が届いて戸惑っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 税通知で来訪し勤務先の税控除があるのに別通知が届き戸惑うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came here because it is a tax notice. I am confused because another notice arrived even though taxes are deducted at work.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you came with a tax notice and are confused by another notice despite tax deductions at work.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この通知の発行元は市になっています。国の税と同じ窓口ではありませんので、まず通知に書かれた担当へご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: The issuing authority on this notice is the city. It is not handled by the same office as national taxes, so please first check with the department named on the notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 税務署ではなく市の担当なのですね。給料から引かれた分と同じ税かどうかも、そちらで聞けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 市の担当と理解し給与控除分と同じ税かもそこで聞くか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it is the city department rather than the tax office. Should I also ask them whether it is the same tax as the one deducted from my salary?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you understand it is the city department and confirm whether to ask there if it is the same tax as your salary deduction.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。給与明細のどの欄が気になっているか、通知とあわせて担当に示すと説明しやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Showing the department the notice together with the particular payslip field you are concerned about will make it easier to explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 明細には二種類の税の欄があります。電話する前に、通知のどの番号を手元に用意しておけばよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 明細に二種の税欄があり通知のどの番号を電話時に用意するか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: There are two tax fields on my payslip. Before calling, which number on the notice should I have ready?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the payslip has two tax fields and ask which notice number to prepare for the call.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 件名と通知番号を確認しておくとよいでしょう。番号のない書式の場合は、氏名や対象の年度など、担当が求める情報を伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: It would be helpful to check the subject heading and notice number. If that format has no number, give the information the department requests, such as your name and the fiscal year concerned.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 対象年度も控えます。納付期限までに説明を聞けない場合、放っておかずに担当へ連絡すべきですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対象年度を控え期限まで説明が聞けない場合も放置せず相談すべきか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will note the fiscal year too. If I cannot get an explanation before the payment deadline, I should contact the department rather than leave it unattended, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will note the fiscal year, and confirm that you should seek advice rather than ignore it if you cannot hear an explanation by the deadline.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。期限への対応や支払いについても、通知の担当へ早めにご相談ください。ここでは個別の納付条件を決めることはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please consult the department responsible for the notice promptly about the deadline and payment too. We cannot decide individual payment conditions here.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通知の担当番号へ連絡して、給与明細の二つの欄との関係を聞きます。期限についても確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通知の担当に給与の二つの税欄との関係と納付期限を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will call the contact number on the notice and ask how it relates to the two tax fields on my payslip. I will also confirm the deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will ask the notice's department about the relationship to the two payslip tax fields and the payment deadline.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 通知と明細をお忘れなくお持ち帰りください。相談先がわかりにくいときは、また案内をお尋ねください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please remember to take your notice and payslip home. If the right contact is unclear, please ask us for directions again. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検査は終わりました。結果の受け取り案内をお渡ししますが、何かご質問はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your tests are finished. I will give you the guidance on receiving the results; do you have any questions?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社へ費用を精算するとき、この結果の案内を出せばよいですか。会計では領収書ももらいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社の費用精算に結果案内を使うか問い会計で領収書も受け取ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I claim reimbursement from my company, should I submit this results guidance? I also received a receipt at the cashier.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the results guidance is used for company reimbursement, and say that you also received a payment receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 結果の案内と支払いの領収書は別の書類です。会社の精算条件はこちらでは判断できませんので、会社に指定を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The results guidance and payment receipt are different documents. We cannot determine your company's reimbursement requirements, so please ask the company what it specifies.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 金額が書いてある領収書を捨ててしまうところでした。健診結果が後日届くことも、会社に伝えたほうがよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 領収書を捨てかけたと伝え結果が後日届くことも会社へ伝えるべきか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I nearly threw away the receipt showing the amount. I should also tell my company that the health-check results will arrive later, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you nearly discarded the receipt, and confirm whether you should tell the company the results will arrive later.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。いつ何を提出するか、会社に確認してください。結果の受け取り方法は、今お渡しした案内に記載されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Please ask the company what to submit and when. The method for receiving the results is written in the guidance I just gave you.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 結果が届くまで領収書も一緒に保管します。領収書の宛名が会社指定と違った場合は、どこに相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 結果が来るまで領収書を保管し宛名が会社指定と異なる場合の相談先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will keep the receipt too until the results arrive. If the name on the receipt differs from what my company requires, where can I ask about it?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will keep the receipt until the results arrive, and ask whom to consult if its addressee differs from the company's requirement.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 領収書の記載に関する相談は会計窓口へお願いします。変更できるかどうかも、元の領収書を見せて確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please ask the cashier about the receipt's entries. Show the original receipt and check with them whether it can be changed as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分で宛名を書き換えず、まず会社の指定を聞いてから会計に相談します。結果票のことは受付で聞けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 宛名を自分で書き換えず会社確認後に会計へ相談し結果票の受取は受付か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not change the addressee myself; I will first ask my company what it requires and then consult the cashier. Should I ask reception about receiving the results sheet?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not rewrite the addressee, will check with the company before consulting the cashier, and ask whether reception handles receiving results.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付で受け取り案内についてお尋ねいただけます。検査内容や結果の意味は、医師の説明で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can ask reception about the receiving instructions. Please confirm the tests' content and the meaning of the results through the doctor's explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 費用の書類は会計、結果の受け取りは受付と覚えておきます。今日は二つの書類を持ち帰って会社に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 費用書類は会計、結果受取は受付と区別し二書類を持ち帰り会社へ確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will remember that expense documents are for the cashier and receiving results is for reception. Today I will take both documents home and check with my company.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish expense documents at the cashier from results collection at reception in Japanese, and say you will take both documents home to check with your company.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それぞれの案内をなくさないようお願いします。結果について心配な点があれば、受診時にご相談ください。どうぞお大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please keep each set of guidance safe. If anything about the results worries you, discuss it during a medical appointment. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今夜のご予約を照合します。ご予約の画面をお見せいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: I will check tonight's reservation. Could you show me your booking screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この予約です。二泊の和室で合っていますか。大きい鞄があるので、部屋までの行き方も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約画面を示し二泊和室かと大きい鞄を持つため部屋への行き方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: This is the booking. Is it correct that it is a Japanese-style room for two nights? I have a large bag, so I also want to know how to reach the room.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show your booking screen in Japanese, confirm a Japanese-style room for two nights, and ask the route to the room because you have a large bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 記録は二泊の和室です。お部屋は二階で、上がる際は階段をご利用いただきます。エレベーターはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The record is for a Japanese-style room for two nights. Your room is on the second floor, and you will need to use the stairs. There is no elevator.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 鞄が重いので、一度に持って上がるのは難しそうです。一階の部屋に変更できるか確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 重い鞄を一度に階段へ運ぶのは難しく一階の部屋へ変えられるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The bag is heavy, so carrying it all upstairs at once seems difficult. Could you check whether I can change to a room on the first floor?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that carrying the heavy bag up the stairs at once is difficult and ask whether a first-floor room is available instead.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一階の空きと、変更した場合の条件を確認します。今の予約をそのままにして、先にご案内してよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check first-floor availability and the conditions if you change. May I leave the current booking unchanged and explain those first?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、条件を聞く前に予約を変えないでください。変えられない場合の荷物の運び方も相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 条件確認前に予約を変えず変更不可なら荷物の運び方を相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, please do not change the booking before explaining the conditions. I would also like to discuss carrying the luggage if changing rooms is impossible.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese not to change the reservation before checking the conditions, and say you want to discuss carrying luggage if a change is unavailable.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。持ち上げる前に、対応できる職員がいるか確認します。ご自身で無理に階段へ運ばず、鞄はここでお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Before lifting it, I will check whether a staff member can help. Do not force yourself to carry it up the stairs; please keep the bag here.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここで待ちます。小さい手荷物だけなら自分で持てますが、大きい鞄の中に貴重品も入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: その場で待ち小荷物は持てるが大きい鞄には貴重品があると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will wait here. I can carry my small hand luggage myself, but the large bag also contains valuables.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will wait there and can carry the small bag, but the large bag contains valuables.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 荷物を職員へ預ける場合は、貴重品を先に取り出してご自身でお持ちください。お部屋と荷物の案内を確認してまいります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you leave luggage with staff, please remove valuables first and keep them with you. I will go check the information about the room and luggage assistance.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 貴重品を手荷物へ移します。部屋の変更条件を聞いてから、二階のままにするか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 貴重品を手荷物へ移し変更条件を聞いて二階のままか判断すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will move the valuables into my hand luggage. After hearing the room-change conditions, I will decide whether to keep the second-floor room.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will move valuables to your hand luggage and decide whether to keep the second-floor room after hearing the change conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認が済み次第、お声がけします。お荷物から離れず、こちらでお待ちください。どうぞご滞在中も遠慮なくお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will speak to you once I have checked. Please stay with your luggage and wait here. Feel free to ask for help during your stay too.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日はこの棚の器に釉薬を掛ける作業を説明します。始める前に、指定の容器を一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Today I will explain how to glaze the pottery on this shelf. Before starting, let us check the designated containers together.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 容器が二つありますが、一つのラベルがにじんで読めません。色が似ていても、中身が同じとは限りませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二容器の一方はラベルがにじみ似た色でも同じ材料とは限らないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are two containers, but one label is smudged and unreadable. Even if the colors look similar, the contents are not necessarily the same, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that one of two container labels is smudged and similar colors do not mean the materials are the same.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そのとおりです。見た目で選ばず、読めないラベルの容器はいったん使わないよう区別します。まだ器に使ってはいませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: That is right. Do not choose by appearance; we will set aside the container with the unreadable label so it is not used for now. Have you already used it on any pottery?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ使っていません。作業台に置いただけなので、ここで待って担当者の確認を受けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: まだ器に使わず台に置いただけで担当の確認を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not used it yet. I only placed it on the workbench, so I will wait here for the responsible person's check.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have only put it on the bench, have not used it on pottery, and will wait for the responsible person's check.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、この確認待ちの場所へ置いてください。容器に勝手に名前を書き足したり、ほかの材料を混ぜたりしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then put it in this area for items awaiting confirmation. Do not add a name to the container yourself or mix in any other materials.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 確認待ちの場所へ移します。正しい容器が決まった後は、使う道具も専用のものを確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 確認待ち場所へ移し容器確定後は専用道具を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will move it to the confirmation area. Once the correct container has been identified, I would also like to check which dedicated tools to use.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will move it to the confirmation area and want to check the dedicated tools after the container is confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 材料と道具の組み合わせを実演で示します。容器の扱いと片付け方も、この工房の安全手順に沿って確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will demonstrate the correct combination of material and tools. We will also check container handling and cleanup according to this workshop's safety procedures.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 説明を聞いてから始めます。掛け終わった器を、窯のそばに自分で運んでよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 説明後に開始し釉薬後の器を自分で窯近くへ運んでよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will start after hearing the explanation. Once a piece is glazed, may I carry it near the kiln myself?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will start after the explanation and ask whether you may carry glazed pottery near the kiln yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 窯の周囲へは、指示があるまで運ばないでください。掛け終わった器は指定の棚へ置き、窯への搬入は担当者が行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do not carry anything around the kiln until instructed. Put glazed pieces on the designated shelf; the responsible staff will load the kiln.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 指定の棚までが自分の担当ですね。ラベルが読めないことを報告して、確認できるまで材料は使いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指定棚までが担当と確認しラベル不明を報告して確認終了まで使わないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: So my responsibility ends at the designated shelf. I will report the unreadable label and not use the materials until they are confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that your responsibility ends at the designated shelf, and say you will report the unclear label and not use the materials until confirmation is complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その判断でお願いします。最初の一枚は担当者と確認して進めましょう。それでは、落ち着いて作業してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please follow that decision. Let us check the first piece with the responsible staff member as you proceed. Work calmly and carefully.
